sources.name: mv12star/lista-telefonos-spam
sources.notes: Repository states that the list is compiled from multiple free web sources. Preserve upstream provenance where available before import.

sources.name: alterine0101/rcs-spam-blocklist
sources.notes: RCS spam dataset. Secondary signal only; do not infer voice-call abuse automatically.

sources.name: FCC Consumer Complaints
sources.notes: Use aggregated complaint signals; complaints are not proof of wrongdoing.

sources.name: FTC Do Not Call Reported Calls Data
sources.notes: Official FTC complaint feed/API. Updated typically each weekday. Reported calls are explicitly unverified; scoring must treat them as signals, not proof.

sources.name: publicdatadepot/us-robocall-complaints-by-phone-number
sources.notes: Aggregated one-row-per-number dataset derived from FTC complaint data and NANPA prefix data. Treat complaint counts and subjects as probabilistic signals; preserve dataset version/hash and source provenance.

sources.name: USACallerLookup robocall complaint dataset/API
sources.notes: Provider states the underlying FTC/NANPA dataset is CC0 and publishes downloadable bulk files. Prefer bulk snapshots over crawling the API; respect rate limits for lookups.

sources.name: SysAdminDoc/CallShield database pipeline
sources.notes: Architecture/source-manifest reference. Evaluate every upstream dataset independently before reuse.
